## Method

Subjects were profiled from public search snippets so a classifier can tell them from namesakes: Nidhi Hooda is the founder of Growpido LLC and is based in Dubai, U.A.E. She describes her work as building the reputation of DIFC leaders and CEOs, and as strategic influence and narrative advisory. Growpido is a Dubai-based reputation advisory and executive reputation company. It works with founders, fund managers, investors, and family offices, and focuses on brand building on LinkedIn and AI search authority. Mentions came from web and news searches; LinkedIn results were kept as search engine snippets and never fetched, nothing behind a login was read. Every mention was classified by gpt-5.4-mini; anything not a confident ignore was classified again by gpt-5.6-terra. The final label follows fixed rules: respond now needs both to agree, any disagreement or any doubt about identity is marked ambiguous and held for a human. Nobody was contacted.
